votes.motion: Approve the work session meeting minutes of August 12, 2025, November 25, 2025, and January 27, 2026, and the formal meeting minutes of July 1, 2025, and August 12, 2025, as well as the January 5, 2026, Oath of Office minutes.
votes.description: Approves multiple sets of prior meeting minutes including work session, formal, and oath of office minutes from mid-2025 through early 2026.

votes.motion: Close the public hearing and defer items B1 through B5 to a future Consent Agenda for action.
votes.description: Closes the public hearing on five grant applications (GREENBike, Red Butte Creek Trail, SLC911 wellness, and police task force) and defers Council action to a future consent agenda.

votes.motion: Close the public hearing and adopt Resolution 1 of 2026, authorizing the sales price and term sheet for The Grove Project, at approximately 321 East 200 South (also known as the Northwest Pipeline Building and adjacent properties).
votes.description: Authorizes the below-market sale of a 2.42-acre City-owned property for $1 million over 55 years to support a mixed-use development including 196 affordable housing units and preservation of the historic Northwest Pipeline building.

votes.motion: Close the public hearing and defer action to a future Council meeting on the Disposition of Alleys and Street Text Amendment ordinance.
votes.description: Closes the public hearing on proposed amendments to the City Code governing the process for closing or vacating public streets or alleys and defers final action to a future meeting.

votes.motion: Adopt Ordinance 5 of 2026 and the remaining items in the budget amendment as proposed by the Administration, close the budget amendment, and accept the friendly amendment to reallocate $50,000 from the Fisher Mansion Project to City Hall's historic displays (increasing historic displays to $150,000 and decreasing Fisher Mansion to $350,000), with Council intent that the Administration adopt a forward-looking policy on wayfinding signage for Downtown parking.
votes.description: Adopts Budget Amendment No. 4 for FY 2025-26 with a friendly amendment reallocating funds between the Fisher Mansion Project and City Hall historic displays, and expresses legislative intent regarding a downtown parking wayfinding signage policy.

votes.motion: Adopt Resolution 4 of 2026, extending the time period to comply with the condition in Ordinance 13 of 2025 for an additional twelve months for the alley vacation near 300 West and Paxton Avenue.
votes.description: Grants the property owner an additional 12 months to satisfy the conditions of a previously adopted ordinance vacating an L-shaped City-owned alley near 268 West Paxton Avenue.

votes.motion: Adopt Resolution 5 of 2026, authorizing up to $51,000,000 of the City's Federally Taxable General Obligation Bonds (Series 2026) for parks, trails, and open space improvements.
votes.description: Authorizes the second issuance of up to $51 million in General Obligation Bonds to fund acquisition, improvement, renovation, and upgrading of City parks, trails, open space, and related recreational facilities.

votes.motion: Approve attendance at the 2026 National Association of Latino Elected and Appointed Officials Conference in Los Angeles from Tuesday, July 14, 2026, to Thursday, July 16, 2026.
votes.description: Approves Council member travel to the 2026 NALEO Conference in Los Angeles per the Council's conference travel policy.

Approves multiple consent items including setting public hearing dates for zoning amendments, grant holding account items, and board appointments/reappointments to the Planning Commission and Arts Council.
